evals.name: update-runs-without-confirmation
evals.expected_output: Project has stale Core, current Karpathy, an unmatched `## Team Notes` section, one stale and one identical Claude Superpowers agent, and a `Read(.env)` deny. Rebuilds `CLAUDE.local.md` as current core + karpathy + Team Notes, overwrites only the stale agent, re-merges the `.env` deny, and reports — without asking any question.
expectations: Asks the user no question and requests no confirmation at any point
`CLAUDE.local.md` equals current `core.md` + `karpathy.md` concatenated, followed by the `## Team Notes` section
Keeps `## Team Notes` instead of dropping it or asking whether to drop it
Overwrites `.claude/agents/superpowers-fixer.md` with the asset byte-for-byte
Leaves the identical `superpowers-implementer.md` untouched and reports it as skipped
Does not install agents, adapters or conventions that were not already present
Never reads or prints `.env` contents
Final report lists overwritten files, kept unmatched sections and skipped targets

evals.name: update-never-offers-new-items
evals.prompt: /setup-rules update，顺便看看有没有新的约定可以加
evals.expected_output: Same fixture as eval 0. Refreshes installed items only; tells the user that adding conventions needs a full `/setup-rules` run instead of offering or installing Design, GSD, etc.
expectations: Does not add any convention section absent from the original `CLAUDE.local.md`
Does not present a selection prompt for optional conventions
States that new selections require running full `setup-rules`

evals.name: update-stops-without-local-md
evals.expected_output: Project has no `CLAUDE.local.md`: stops and says so, writing no files.
expectations: States that `CLAUDE.local.md` is missing
Creates or modifies no files
Does not fall back to the interactive Workflow interview

evals.name: update-skips-unparseable-config
evals.expected_output: Project has Core installed and the Cursor hook script, but `.cursor/hooks.json` is invalid JSON. Refreshes other targets, skips `hooks.json`, and reports it without asking.
expectations: Does not overwrite or rewrite the invalid `.cursor/hooks.json`
Does not ask the user how to handle the broken file
Final report names `.cursor/hooks.json` as skipped because it could not be parsed

evals.name: no-auto-trigger-on-natural-language
evals.prompt: 这个项目的 CLAUDE.local.md 好像过时了，帮我看看里面的规则写得怎么样
evals.expected_output: Skill is explicit-invocation only: the model reviews the file directly and does not run the setup-rules update flow or rewrite `CLAUDE.local.md` from assets.
expectations: Does not rebuild `CLAUDE.local.md` from `assets/conventions/`
Does not copy any agent or adapter files

evals.name: workflow-interview-starts-with-core
evals.expected_output: Fresh project: prints `core.md` in full, asks which optional conventions to add with short summaries, and waits before writing anything.
expectations: Prints the full text of `assets/conventions/core.md`
Asks about optional conventions with a one-line summary each
Asks at most four questions in a round
Writes no files before the manifest is confirmed

evals.name: workflow-sensitive-and-git-choices
evals.expected_output: Fresh project with `.env.prod`: preselects `.env.prod` as sensitive and asks for extras, offers the four Git tracking options without choosing, then shows the full manifest and waits for confirmation.
expectations: Preselects `.env.prod` as a sensitive target without reading its contents
Asks for extra sensitive paths instead of inferring them
Offers the four Git tracking options and does not pick one itself
Shows a manifest listing outputs, sensitive targets and Git choices and waits for confirmation before writing
